summary: This schedule interface displays a multi-day event agenda (like a hackathon or conference) organized chronologically with category badges and time zone controls. It allows users to filter or view event sessions based on their preferred time zone.

stack.name: React + Vite
stack.why: Provides a fast dev setup and component-driven workflow suited for managing interactive schedule lists.

stack.name: Tailwind CSS
stack.why: Enables precise custom styling for retro/brutalist design tokens like hard borders, custom yellow/teal colors, and monospaced typography.

stack.name: Lucide React
stack.why: Offers lightweight UI icons for window headers and control indicators.

components.name: WindowHeader
components.purpose: Renders the desktop window header chrome with control buttons and title text.

components.name: ControlsHeader
components.purpose: Displays time zone selector controls, 'USE MINE' action button, and category filter badges.

components.name: DateGroup
components.purpose: Wraps schedule items under a prominent date banner badge.

components.name: EventCard
components.purpose: Displays an individual session item with time, title, location details, tag category, and distinct background theme.

components.name: CategoryBadge
components.purpose: Renders styled tag indicators for event types (Kickoff, Workshop, Deadline, Ceremony).

steps.title: Project Setup & Token Configuration
steps.detail: Initialize a React Vite project and configure Tailwind CSS theme variables using the measured design tokens (#fffcf1 background, #fde669 primary yellow, #e3f1ee surface teal, dark borders). Add monospace font imports to match retro typography.

steps.title: Build Window Container Shell
steps.detail: Create the outer retro window frame with thick black borders, top window controls bar ('WindowHeader'), and main content scrolling area.

steps.title: Implement Schedule Header Controls
steps.detail: Construct the header section containing title text, timezone selection dropdown, 'USE MINE' button, and category legend indicators ('KICKOFF', 'WORKSHOP', 'DEADLINE', 'CEREMONY').

steps.title: Build Event Card & Date Grouping Components
steps.detail: Develop 'DateGroup' for date banners ('FRI, OCT 9') and 'EventCard' with conditional styling for workshops versus kickoffs, rounded inner borders, and badge overlays.

steps.title: Wire Dynamic Time Zone Logic
steps.detail: Implement state for selected time zone and convert event timestamps dynamically when switching zones or clicking 'USE MINE' to detect the browser timezone.

steps.title: Add Responsive Padding & Verification
steps.detail: Ensure schedule cards stack properly on smaller viewports while maintaining high contrast text, crisp border alignments, and exact visual match to design tokens.

behaviour: Dropdown change: updates all session start/end times displayed across the agenda to match selected time zone offset.
USE MINE button: detects browser navigator time zone and sets the select element value automatically.
Category badge clicks: optionally toggles filter visibility for specific event types (e.g. show only workshops).
Session card hover/click: opens detailed modal or expands card to show full description and join links.
data: events: id, date, startTime, endTime, title, platform, channel, category ('kickoff' | 'workshop' | 'deadline' | 'ceremony'), timeZoneOffset

tokens.method: Colours: pixel quantisation of the whole screenshot and of each detected element. Font sizes: text box height ÷ 1.25. Spacing: gaps between sibling boxes, snapped to a 4px grid. Measured approximations, not values read from source code.
